email.subject: Interview confirmed: Robotics Software Engineer
email.body:
Hello,

This email confirms your in-person interview for the Robotics Software Engineer position at Redwater Robotics on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 10:00.

Address: Redwater Robotics, Building B, Innovation Park
Duration: about 2 hours
Interviewers: Dr. Elena Park (Controls) and Sam Okafor (Perception)

Please bring a photo ID. If you need to reschedule, reply at least 24 hours in advance.

Regards,
Redwater Robotics Careers
